question: 数码电子类在哪个渠道销量最好
gold_sql: SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id left join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id left join channels c on o.channel_id = c.channel_id where p.category_id = 1 AND o.status = '已完成' group by c.channel_name order by SUM(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT ch.channel_name
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE c.category_name = '数码电子' AND o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY ch.channel_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1
